description_en: Queries the basic information of a voice call task
description_zh: 查询呼叫任务基础信息
name: QueryAiCallTaskDetail

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only when the RAM permission verification fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AgentId.description_en: The code of the published agent

items.description_en:
The callable day. Valid values:

MONDAY: Monday.

TUESDAY: Tuesday.

WEDNESDAY: Wednesday.

THURSDAY: Thursday.

FRIDAY: Friday.

SATURDAY: Saturday.

SUNDAY: Sunday
items.description_zh:
可呼叫日。取值：

MONDAY：周一。

TUESDAY：周二。

WEDNESDAY：周三。

THURSDAY：周四。

FRIDAY：周五。

SATURDAY：周六。

SUNDAY：周天

CallExpireDate.description_en: The expiration date of outbound call details (specific deadline) in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
CallExpireDate.description_zh: 外呼明细过期日期（具体截止时间），格式：YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

CallExpireMinutes.description_en: The expiration duration of outbound call details. Unit: minutes
CallExpireMinutes.description_zh: 外呼明细过期时长（分钟）

CallExpireType.description_en:
The expiration type of outbound calls. Valid values:

0: permanently valid.
1: valid for a period of time after import.
2: valid until a specified time
CallExpireType.description_zh:
外呼有效期类型：

0：长期有效；
1：导入后一段时间内有效；
2：截止指定时间有效；

items.description_en: The configuration of an allowed call time period

EndTime.description_en: The end time in the format of HH:mm:ss

StartTime.description_en: The start time in the format of HH:mm:ss

CallableTimes.description_en: The callable time periods of the current outbound call instance
CallableTimes.description_zh: 当前外呼实例可呼叫时段

items.description_en: The callable time periods of the current outbound call instance
items.description_zh: 当前外呼实例可呼叫时段

EndTime.description_en: The end time in the format of HH:mm:ss

StartTime.description_en: The start time in the format of HH:mm:ss

LinePhoneNum.description_en: The phone number of the custom line

PhoneType.description_en: The phone number type. Valid values: 0 indicates an Alibaba Cloud number. 1 indicates a custom line provided by the customer
PhoneType.description_zh: 号码类型。取值：0 表示阿里云号码，1 表示客户自带线路

RealStartTime.description_en: The actual start time of the task. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
RealStartTime.description_zh: 任务真实启动时间，时间戳，单位：毫秒

RetryEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether call retry is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
RetryEnable.description_zh:
是否开启呼叫重试。取值：
true：开启。
false：未开启

RetryReasons.description_en: The list of failure reasons that allow retry
RetryReasons.description_zh: 允许失败重呼的原因列表

items.description_en:
The specific retry reason. Valid values:

CALL_REJECTED: The call is rejected.

USER_BUSY: The callee is busy.

SUSPEND: The number is suspended.

INVALID_NUMBER: The number is invalid.

POWERED_OFF: The phone is powered off.

NETWORK_BUSY: The network is busy.

NO_ANSWER: No answer
items.description_zh:
具体重试原因。取值：

CALL_REJECTED：拒接。

USER_BUSY：被叫忙。

SUSPEND：停机。

INVALID_NUMBER：空号。

POWERED_OFF：关机。

NETWORK_BUSY：网络忙。

NO_ANSWER：无应答

StartTime.description_en: The scheduled start time of the task. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 任务预设启动时间，时间戳，单位：毫秒

StartType.description_en:
The start mode. Valid values:

IMMEDIATE: Start immediately.

SCHEDULE: Start at a scheduled time
StartType.description_zh:
启动方式。取值：

IMMEDIATE：立即启动。

SCHEDULE：定时启动

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if the call is successful
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
